name: AutomationDirect WAL3B enclosure handle
summary: WAL3B enclosure handle arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: WAL3B is the drawing identifier for enclosure handle in AutomationDirect's Enclosure Accessories collection. An enclosure handle operates or assists access to the selected lid or door arrangement. It is not automatically a complete locking or electrical interlocking system.

For example, in a cabinet door with a selected handle and locking arrangement, use the WAL3B reference to coordinate handle fixing, operating hand space and door movement. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/Enclosure Accessories/WAL3B.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep handle fixing, operating hand space and door movement visible in the layout.
This reference concerns the named WAL3B drawing and its enclosure handle role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
